headline: Vivent Health expanding integrated care footprint with major renovation; limited email security relevance detected

signals.summary: Vivent Health unveiled a $1.6M renovation expanding integrated care services in Green Bay, signaling physical infrastructure investment and potential staffing growth.
signals.suggestedAction: Reach out to the operations or IT leadership to understand the scope of the Green Bay expansion—new clinical staff and admin roles may need email seats. Offer a brief assessment of their current HIPAA email compliance posture as a courtesy.
